a.id, a.biz_type, a.biz_id, a.applicant_id, a.village_id, a.audit_status, a.audit_remark, a.submit_time, a.audit_time, u.real_name AS applicant_name, u.phone AS applicant_phone, u.credit_score AS applicant_credit, u.realname_status AS realname_status, v.village_name AS applicant_village_name,
CONCAT(LEFT(u.id_card, 6), '********', RIGHT(u.id_card, 4)) AS id_card, u.id_card_front, u.id_card_back, r.resource_name, r.cover_url AS resource_cover, r.description AS resource_description, r.price, r.price_unit, r.trade_type, r.risk_level, r.resource_status, c.category_name, au.real_name AS auditor_name

FROM sys_audit_record a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.applicant_id LEFT JOIN sys_village v ON v.id = a.village_id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.id = a.auditor_id
LEFT JOIN biz_resource r ON a.biz_type = 2 AND r.id = a.biz_id LEFT JOIN biz_resource_category c ON c.id = r.category_id

sql.if: AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR r.resource_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
